sentences.en: Two observations about John in this episode.

sentences.en: The first one has to do with his hair.
sentences.zh: 第一个与他的发型有关。

sentences.en: John has a full-on bowl haircut in this.
sentences.zh: 约翰在这集里留了一个十足的锅盖头。

sentences.en: Sam, can you pull up a picture of John in this to show Jenna?
sentences.zh: 萨姆，你能调出一张约翰这张照片给杰娜看看吗？

sentences.en: I grew up in a small town, and some of these farm boys,
sentences.zh: 我在一个小镇长大，有些农场男孩，

sentences.zh: 他们就在头上扣个碗，然后顺着碗边剪头发。

sentences.en: And every time I hear him say D-White, it just makes me smile.
sentences.zh: 每次听到他叫“迪-怀特”，我就忍不住微笑。

sentences.en: So there are my two John observations.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我对约翰的两点观察。

sentences.en: I have an observation about Jim in this episode, which is, and actually, a fan pointed this

我本来注意到了，但我要给另一个注意到这点的人点个赞，只不过我没记下他们的名字。

sentences.en: I had noticed it, but I will give some props to the other person who noticed it, except

sentences.zh: 就像这集开头时问他的那样。

here, it cost him and everyone else in the office decent health care.

sentences.en: So I'm not sure he could have done much better than Dwight, but maybe he could have.
sentences.zh: 所以我不确定他能比德怀特做得好多少，但也许他能吧。

sentences.en: Does that make him kind of not as charming?
sentences.zh: 这会不会让他显得没那么有魅力了？

sentences.en: I think what happens in this show is that Michael passes the buck to Jim, and Jim passes

sentences.zh: 推给德怀特，这种情况一次又一次地发生。

sentences.zh: 吉姆的态度就像是，听着，我拿的这点工资可不干这活。

sentences.en: Well, and I think the argument really can be made that Jim knew it was inevitable.

sentences.zh: 在15分50秒左右，镜头闪过了墙上的时钟。

所有这些自我肯定都是什么？

他是我们的布景设计师。

sentences.en: And then the props department would, any time there was some sheet of paper that we had to
sentences.zh: 而且道具部门总是这样，每当有什么纸张需要我们

sentences.en: look at as a prop, it was a fully formed idea.
sentences.zh: 作为道具去查看时，那都是一个完整的概念。

sentences.en: You know, if there was a memo, they wrote out, like, a whole real fake memo.

sentences.en: There's always funny little jokes hidden in them.
sentences.zh: 里面总是藏着搞笑的小笑话。

sentences.zh: 磁贴，全都是斯克兰顿的。

sentences.zh: 它们散落在我们办公室的各处。

sentences.en: That's what should be your playliSt.

sentences.zh: 你们本来就该听听小青蛙电台的。

sentences.en: This episode ends with Michael coming out of his office.
sentences.zh: 这集以迈克从办公室走出来结束。

sentences.en: He's successfully hidden in his office until 5 p.m., after 5 p.m.
sentences.zh: 他成功把自己关在办公室直到下午五点，过了下午五点。

sentences.en: And the entire office is waiting to confront him, both about the horrible health care plan
sentences.zh: 整个办公室都在等着找他算账，不仅是为了德怀特选的那个糟糕的医疗方案

sentences.en: that Dwight picked, and to finally find out, please, what is the surprise?
sentences.zh: 也是为了最终搞清楚，求求了，惊喜到底是什么？

sentences.zh: 因为他进来时试图用冰淇淋三明治给我们一个惊喜。

sentences.zh: 哦，他差点用冰淇淋三明治砸到我的头。

sentences.en: I mean, Steve actually, like, the look on his face after that take, he was like,
sentences.zh: 我是说，史蒂夫拍完那条之后的表情，他当时说，

sentences.en: Ange, how close did that come?

sentences.zh: 我说，史蒂夫，你几乎是用它砸到我头了。

sentences.en: And he also announced so proudly, Operation Surprise.
sentences.zh: 而且他还那么骄傲地宣布，惊喜行动。

sentences.en: And so we're like, okay, what is it?
sentences.zh: 所以我们就想，好吧，那是什么？

sentences.en: And it's all he could come up with in his whole day was ice cream sandwiches.
sentences.zh: 结果他折腾了一整天，想出来的竟然只有冰淇淋三明治。

sentences.en: And then he says that's not the surprise.
sentences.zh: 然后他说那并不是惊喜。

sentences.en: It's surprising, but it is not the surprise.
sentences.zh: 这确实挺让人意外，但它不是那个惊喜。

sentences.en: So at the end of the episode, you confront him.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一集快结束时，你们找他质问。

sentences.en: I loved being the person that confronted him because Steve is so funny.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢当那个质问他的人，因为史蒂夫太搞笑了。

sentences.en: And he turned to me and he's like, yes, Angela.
sentences.zh: 他转过头看着我说，好的，安吉拉。

sentences.en: So you ask him, point blank, what is the surprise, Michael?
sentences.zh: 所以你单刀直入地问他，迈克，惊喜到底是什么？

sentences.zh: 我们所有人都只是看着他。

sentences.zh: 我记得我们拍的时候，计算着时间，直到我们开始逐个慢慢离开的那个瞬间。

sentences.en: It really did as we were standing there.
sentences.zh: 当我们站在那儿的时候，它确实发生了。

sentences.en: And they had choreographed the order in which we would leave.
sentences.zh: 他们还编排好了我们离开的顺序。

sentences.zh: 所以我们得回来重新就位。

sentences.en: And this was, like, a whole different rhythm.
sentences.zh: 而这完全是另一种节奏。

sentences.en: And I remember he just had to stand there.
sentences.zh: 我记得他就得站在那里。

sentences.zh: 比如，他第二天怎么好意思回来，然后说，我们都知道其实没有什么惊喜。

sentences.en: But, man, we made him suffer through that pause.
sentences.zh: 但是，天哪，我们让他活活熬过了那个停顿。

sentences.en: And then, best last line ever.
sentences.zh: 然后，史上最棒的最后一句话来了。

sentences.en: After that suffering silence, Rain says, oh, Jan wants you to call her.
sentences.zh: 在经历那段令人难受的沉默之后，雷恩说，哦，简让你给她回个电话。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, Rainn Wilson.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，雷恩·威尔逊。

sentences.en: And it was just so great to hear your voice.
